summary: Re-ran complete T4 verification against the live Sage server after T4_fix.
final_report: FAIL: focused pytest passed 34 tests and full pytest passed 298 tests. All requested UI, API, SSE, workspace, and delete checks passed except the Home first-message persistence flow. At 375x812 home the closed sidebar computed width/min/max 0px, visibility hidden, pointer-events none, rect width 0 and no hitbox; composer rect x=16 y=735.5 right=359 bottom=792 was fully inside viewport; Menu opened and backdrop displayed, and Escape restored the closed state. At 1280x800 home there was exactly one h1, scrollWidth/clientWidth were 1280, composer rect x=339.84375 bottom=768 was visible, and the Sage link resolved to /. All six pages returned 200 at 375x812 and 1280x800, each had exactly one h1, no overflow, interactive elements, no uncaught errors or non-favicon failed responses. Workspace rendered Sage plus the session title and nested GET data; its composer was visible. Sessions UI delete created temporary id 9344707bfdd94d6fa9b049c3c95db29d, found one actual Delete button, accepted confirmation, and verified DOM removal, API list removal, and GET 404. API health/sessions/files/preferences/create/full GET/title/delete returned 200/200/200/200/200/200/200/204; SSE returned 200 text/event-stream with meta, delta events, and final done, and full GET contained user plus assistant messages. Home prompt T4 home flow exact send second 2026 produced exactly one session creation, but no POST /turns request was observed, URL stayed /, fallback text was visible, and GET full session 83aa6b6d1bba4605b80af1146ed2e310 returned messages=[]. The mandated verify_ui.mjs was also blocked: Node could not resolve playwright from the global script, ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

recommendations: Fix the home first-send async path so POST /api/sessions/{id}/turns executes after session creation; current flow creates and titles the session but leaves messages empty.
Expose Playwright to the mandated verify_ui.mjs module resolution path, then rerun it and retain four-breakpoint screenshots.
Do not delete existing user sessions; temporary verification records created in this pass were deleted.
notes: Read T4_fix.json first. No source files were modified. Equivalent live Playwright probes captured computed styles, page matrix, UI delete, workspace, home, API and SSE evidence.
